description: Fetch a run's current status, summary, pending approvals, and (once settled) the agent's final reply.
name: get_run

outputSchema.description: A task run — one delegated job and what is known about its state.

items.description: A file the work produced. Exchange its id for a download link with get_file_download_url.

cancel_requested_at.description: Set once a stop was requested; the run stays running until it reaches its next step, then settles as cancelled.

json.description: The reply parsed as JSON and validated against response_format. Present only when one was given.

json_error.description: Why the reply did not parse or validate against response_format.

wait_timed_out.description: The wait ended first. The work is still running: follow it with the tool next_step names.
